section may be established when-

(a)
any  person  or  body  of  persons  assigned  with  the

and

(b)
for  the  purposes  of  subsection  (2),  investigative
actions have to be carried out in Sri Lanka and the
other foreign State simultaneously.
(4) Information obtained during joint investigations may
be used by competent courts, where the persons who were
been investigated are tried in such courts.

62.
(1)  The  Commission,  the  Director-General  or  any
other officer or employee of the Commission or any person
whose  services  are  retained  under  section  27  shall  not  be
compelled to reveal the source or the manner of obtaining
any information received under the provisions of this Act.
(2) The Commission may share information relevant to
any investigation with any local law enforcement authority
or  any  other  Government  authority  or  any  other  law
enforcement  authority  as  provided  under  international
bilateral  or  multilateral  agreements  or  arrangements,  or  in
the absence of such agreements or arrangements on a case-
by-case basis for the purposes of investigation, prosecution
and judicial proceedings under the law of the foreign State.
